Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded falcon account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence as the vault binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Honest users pay that once, farms 32 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
